findings.rule: A page rendered from a store whose events carry a blocked term passes the scan.
findings.input: PUSH_BLOCKLIST="term" (or "BLOCKLIST", "PUSH") and an event note "term sheet": the mask writes "[PUSH_BLOCKLIST term 1] sheet", and scanText finds the term "term" inside the label it wrote.
findings.finding: The mask writes labels that can themselves contain a blocked term's value, so a page masked from an event carrying such a term still fails the scan.
